**Goal.** Get fluent in the authors' models, then simulate from `mod1` on the real design and check whether glmmTMB recovers what you put in. Today has no spatial structure: the location intercepts are iid. Finish with Hefley's equivalent specifications, so you can see the location intercept as the simplest basis-function model.

## Checklist

- [ ] Map Q1–Q5 to scripts and write each model as an equation
- [ ] Save β, σ_LocationID and φ from `mod1` to `results/`
- [ ] Write `sim_stage1()` in `sim/stage1.R`
- [ ] Refit 500 replicates; summarize bias, coverage, spread of σ̂
- [ ] Compare against a plain `glm` that ignores location
- [ ] Read Hefley, Model Specifications + Equivalent Specifications (Eqs. 4–13)
- [ ] Derivation: Eq. 7 and Eq. 9 (in `notes/derivations.qmd`)

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("../sim/_load.R")
library(glmmTMB)
HTrees1 <- read.table(file.path(data_dir, "abundance.tree.and.controls.txt"),
                      header = TRUE, dec = ".")
```

## 2. Save the stage-1 truth

Fit the final `mod1` (Treatment + DistReef + (1 | LocationID), `nbinom1`) and save β, σ_LocationID and φ to `results/`.

**Done when:** `results/` contains an .rds with the three parameter sets, and you can read it back.

```{r}
#| label: save-truth
library(glmmTMB)
HTrees1 = HTrees1 |> mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment))
mod1 <- glmmTMB(Abundance ~ Treatment + Trees50 + WMI + DistReef + DistIsland
                + (1 | LocationID),
                family = nbinom1(),
                data = HTrees1)

saveRDS(mod1, "/workspaces/mangrovebackreef/espm215/results/stage1_mod1.RDS")

```
